metadata.content: Man Utd goalkeeper Senne Lammens criticised for howler in Sporting draw by Jamie Carragher | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Man Utd goalkeeper Senne Lammens criticised for howler in Sporting draw by Jamie Carragher Jamie Carragher felt Man Utd were 'unlucky' to be controversially denied two goals by refereeing decisions and said Mauricio Pochettino will feel like his side were 'robbed' of what would have been a 'really big win' Jamie Carragher Football Expert and Columnist Thursday 26 November 2026 00:09, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Manchester United boss Mauricio Pochettino insists it's 'difficult to understand' why Amad Diallo's late goal was ruled out for a foul on Sporting Lisbon keeper Kaique Jamie Carragher says Manchester United goalkeeper Senne Lammens' confidence is a cause for concern after his howler cost Mauricio Pochettino a first win since taking charge. It was a nightmare performance for Lammens, who unnecessarily gave away the penalty for Luis Suarez's opener just 75 seconds after saving the Sporting striker's poorly taken first spot-kick. Lammens, 24, then spilled a routine cross late in the second half which allowed Suarez to equalise for 2-2, denying United a first away win of the season and first away Champions League win for five years. messages.text: Dubois vs Parker announced for WBO heavyweight title clash

metadata.summary: Daniel Dubois will defend the WBO heavyweight world championship against Joseph Parker on January 30 at Manchester's Co-op Live arena.
metadata.content: Daniel Dubois to fight Joseph Parker in WBO heavyweight world championship clash in Manchester on January 30 | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Daniel Dubois to fight Joseph Parker in WBO heavyweight world championship clash in Manchester on January 30 Daniel Dubois will box former world champion Joseph Parker on January 30 at Manchester's Co-op Live arena; Dubois will be defending the WBO heavyweight world title he secured defeating Fabio Wardley; Parker has had his suspension lifted Wednesday 25 November 2026 20:00, UK Image: Daniel Dubois will fight Joseph Parker next in Manchester on January 30 Daniel Dubois will defend the WBO heavyweight world championship against Joseph Parker on January 30 at Manchester's Co-op Live arena. Dubois and Parker were due to box in 2025 for the IBF title, only for Dubois to fall ill and withdraw just three days before the fight. Parker knocked out short-notice replacement Martin Bakole and then lost a WBO Interim title bout to Fabio Wardley. In August he announced that he could continue his career after a suspension was lifted following a failed drug test in October 2025.
